data.body: Pilot store, 5d28-7811-5391-4bd6 closed, which matches the precedent that a pilot ticket closes when ADP promotes its PR rather than when the PR merges, as 6948, 6a3f and a6e6 are all closed against open PRs. 53ed-ac2d-7739-4194 stays in_progress because it is genuinely unfinished, with its findings and its prerequisite recorded on the ticket.
